# Agni by Ravan.ai - Full Documentation for LLMs

> Agni is the world's most natural voice AI platform by Ravan.ai. Real emotion. Real turn-taking. Real conversation. Not a chatbot. Not a script. Just talk.

## Platform Overview

Agni provides enterprise-grade real-time voice AI agents. Key capabilities:

### Voice AI Engine
- Sub-300ms end-to-end latency for human-speed conversations
- Real emotion and natural turn-taking (not clip stitching)
- Model-agnostic runtime that dynamically routes across providers
- 50+ language support with native fluency
- Configurable voice profiles, temperature, and speaking style
- Background ambient sounds (office, cafe)
- Voicemail detection and automated messages

### Telephony
- Twilio integration for phone numbers
- Two strategies: BYOT (Bring Your Own Twilio) or Managed
- Inbound call routing with dispatch rules
- Outbound calling capabilities
- SIP address support for call transfers
- Phone number pricing: ~$1.15/month, inbound ~$0.0085/min, outbound ~$0.0945/min

### Agent Configuration
- System prompt with dynamic variables ({{variable_name}})
- LLM model selection (gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, etc.)
- Voice profile selection
- Temperature control (0.0 - 1.0)
- Welcome message and turn-taking config
- Reminder triggers for silence detection
- Max call duration limits
- Post-call analysis with custom prompts
- Structured output extraction

### Integrations
- GoHighLevel (GHL): Calendar, appointments, OAuth
- Cal.com: Event types, appointment booking, OAuth
- Webhooks: After-call events, status updates
- RAG Knowledge Base: Document upload, query, discovery

### API
- REST API at https://api.ravan.ai
- Authentication: X-Api-Key header
- Response envelope: { success, message, data, meta }
- Pagination: limit & offset parameters
- Error codes: 200, 400, 401, 404, 422, 500

### API Endpoints

#### Agents
- POST /api/v1/agents/ - Create agent
- GET /api/v1/agents/{id} - Get agent
- GET /api/v1/agents/ - List agents
- PUT /api/v1/agents/{id} - Update agent
- PATCH /api/v1/agents/{id}/status - Update status
- DELETE /api/v1/agents/{id} - Delete agent

#### Tools
- POST /api/v1/tools/ - Create tool
- GET /api/v1/tools/{id} - Get tool
- GET /api/v1/tools/ - List tools
- PUT /api/v1/tools/{id} - Update tool
- DELETE /api/v1/tools/{id} - Delete tool

#### Contacts
- POST /api/v1/contacts/ - Create contact
- GET /api/v1/contacts/{id} - Get contact
- GET /api/v1/contacts/ - List contacts
- PUT /api/v1/contacts/{id} - Update contact
- DELETE /api/v1/contacts/{id} - Delete contact
- POST /api/v1/contacts/bulk-delete - Bulk delete
- GET /api/v1/contacts/{id}/detail - Get detail
- GET /api/v1/contacts/{id}/calls - Get calls
- GET /api/v1/contacts/{id}/call-stats - Get call stats
- GET /api/v1/contacts/{id}/activities - Get activities
- GET /api/v1/contacts/{id}/campaigns - Get campaigns
- POST /api/v1/contacts/{id}/notes - Create note
- GET /api/v1/contacts/{id}/notes - List notes

#### Telephony
- GET /api/v1/telephony/available-numbers - List available
- POST /api/v1/telephony/buy-number - Buy number
- POST /api/v1/telephony/release-number - Release number
- GET /api/v1/telephony/purchased-numbers - List purchased
- POST /api/v1/telephony/import-number - Import number
- GET /api/v1/telephony/twilio-numbers - List Twilio numbers

#### RAG Knowledge Base
- POST /api/v1/rag/documents - Upsert document
- GET /api/v1/rag/documents/{id} - Get document
- GET /api/v1/rag/documents - List documents
- GET /api/v1/rag/knowledgebases - List knowledge bases
- POST /api/v1/rag/query - Query knowledge base
- POST /api/v1/rag/discover - Discover content
- POST /api/v1/rag/refresh - Refresh index
- POST /api/v1/rag/exclusions - Manage exclusions
- GET /api/v1/rag/exclusions - List exclusions

#### Widget Settings
- POST /api/v1/widget-settings/ - Create
- GET /api/v1/widget-settings/{id} - Get
- GET /api/v1/widget-settings/ - List
- PUT /api/v1/widget-settings/{id} - Update
- DELETE /api/v1/widget-settings/{id} - Delete

#### Cal.com Integration
- POST /api/v1/calcom/connect - Connect
- POST /api/v1/calcom/disconnect - Disconnect
- GET /api/v1/calcom/status - Check status
- GET /api/v1/calcom/event-types - List event types
- GET /api/v1/calcom/event-types/lookup - Lookup event type
- GET /api/v1/calcom/appointments - List appointments
- GET /api/v1/calcom/appointments/{id} - Get appointment

#### GHL Integration
- GET /api/v1/ghl/appointments - List appointments
- GET /api/v1/ghl/appointments/{id} - Get appointment
- GET /api/v1/ghl/oauth/authorize - OAuth authorize
- GET /api/v1/ghl/oauth/callback - OAuth callback
- GET /api/v1/ghl/setup-status - Setup status
- GET /api/v1/ghl/calendars - List calendars
- GET /api/v1/ghl/agent-by-calendar - Get agent by calendar
- POST /api/v1/ghl/disconnect - Disconnect

#### Health
- GET /api/v1/health - Health check
- GET /api/v1/health/ready - Readiness check

### Pricing
- Voice AI: $0.07 per minute (flat rate, no tiering)
- Phone numbers: ~$1.15/month per number
- Inbound calls: ~$0.0085/min
- Outbound calls: ~$0.0945/min
- Prepaid credit system
- No platform tax or hidden fees
